test_title: PYST 11: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.**

The current state of the literature / on the efficacy under cognitive-behavioural therapy / for individuals with generalised anxiety disorder / suggests that it is a promising treatment option.

options.text: on the efficacy under cognitive-behavioural therapy
for individuals with generalised anxiety disorder
The current state of the literature
suggests that it is a promising treatment option.

solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"on the efficacy under cognitive-behavioural therapy."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The preposition** "under"** is incorrect in "on the efficacy under cognitive-behavioural therapy.&
